scope: The original two-storey Tao Heung Food Museum at 1 Lok Tin Street, Fanling, as photographed in October 2006. The glazed entrance below the projecting sign canopy, two stairs and metal forecourt gates are included.

originalReview.notes: Original 8 October 2006 photograph published by Chong Fat. Cleared version reviewed from Qualla first. Only the exact original native bytes informed the represented appearance.

quallaSearch.notes: Started with the published Qualla source. Its exact bytes match the later Commons version of Chong Fat’s 2006 scene. Used only the first version uploaded by the photographer, with its same-account Chinese Wikipedia public-domain release and original native SHA-1. The later contrast edit supplied no architectural details.
